title: chamaemelum achilleifolium
intro: Chamaemelum achilleifolium, commonly known as Chamomile, is a perennial herb that belongs to the daisy family and is native to Europe and Western Asia. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and insomnia, and soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Chamomile include flavonoids, terpenoids, and volatile oils, which exert therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Chamomile include promoting relaxation, reducing inflammation, and calming the skin, making it a popular natural remedy for various health concerns.
